arxiv-2011-11056.title: Polynomization of the Chern–Fu–Tang conjecture
arxiv-2011-11056.creator: Bernhard Heim, Markus Neuhauser
arxiv-2011-11056.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Bernhard Heim, Markus Neuhauser. Bessenrodt and Ono’s work on additive and multiplicative properties of the partition function and DeSalvo and Pak’s paper on the log-concavity of the partition function have generated many beautiful theorems and conjectures. In January 2020, the first author gave a lecture at the MPIM in Bonn on a conjecture of Chern–Fu–Tang, and presented an extension (joint work with Neuhauser) involving polynomials. Partial results have been announced.

arxiv-2012-00123.creator: Yujia Xie, Yixiu Mao, Simiao Zuo, Hongteng Xu
arxiv-2012-00123.description: Abstract We consider a variant of regression problem, where the correspondence between input and output data is not available. Such shuffled data is commonly observed in many real world problems. Taking flow cytometry as an example, the measuring instruments may not be able to maintain the correspondence between the samples and the measurements.

arxiv-2203-10557.title: A Neural-Symbolic Approach to Natural Language Understanding
arxiv-2203-10557.creator: Zhixuan LiuShanghai Jiaotong University lzx993124494@sjtu.edu.cn, Zihao WangCSE, HKUST zwanggc@cse.ust.hk Yuan LinByteDance AI Lab linyuan.0@bytedance.com Hang LiByteDance AI Lab lihang.lh@bytedance.com
arxiv-2203-10557.description: Abstract Deep neural networks, empowered by pre-trained language models, have achieved remarkable results in natural language understanding (NLU) tasks. However, their performances can drastically deteriorate when logical reasoning is needed. This is because NLU in principle depends on not only analogical reasoning, which deep neural networks are good at, but also logical reasoning.

arxiv-2203-15631.title: Scintillation detectors with silicon photomultiplier readout in a dilution refrigerator at temperatures down to 0.2 K
arxiv-2203-15631.creator: and A. Soter
arxiv-2203-15631.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by and A. Soter. We are developing a novel high-brightness atomic beam, comprised of a two-body exotic atom called muonium (M = μ + + e − =\mu^{+}+e^{-} ), for next-generation atomic physics and gravitational interaction measurements. This M source originates from a thin sheet of superfluid helium (SFHe), hence diagnostics and later measurements require a detection system which is operational in a dilution cryostat at temperatures below 1 K 1\text{\,}\mathrm{K} .

arxiv-2305-03833.title: Small transitive homogeneous 3 3 - ( v , { 4 , 6 } , 1 ) (v,\{4,6\},1) designs
arxiv-2305-03833.creator: Michael Epstein, Donald L. Kreher, Spyros S. Magliveras
arxiv-2305-03833.description: Abstract A 3 3 - ( v , { 4 , 6 } , 1 ) (v,\{4,6\},1) design is a configuration of v v points and a collection of 4 4 - and 6 6 -element subsets called blocks, that jointly contain every 3-element subset exactly once.

arxiv-2402-04128.title: Multipass Quantum Process Tomography: Precision and Accuracy Enhancement
arxiv-2402-04128.creator: Stancho G. Stanchev and Nikolay V. Vitanov
arxiv-2402-04128.description: Abstract We introduce a method to enhance the precision and accuracy of Quantum Process Tomography (QPT) by mitigating the errors caused by state preparation and measurement (SPAM), readout and shot noise. Instead of performing QPT solely on a single gate, we propose performing QPT on a sequence of multiple applications of the same gate.

arxiv-2406-15629.title: Embedded multi-boson exchange: A step beyond quantum cluster theories
arxiv-2406-15629.creator: Dominik Kiese, Nils Wentzell, Igor Krivenko, Olivier Parcollet, Karsten Held, Friedrich Krien
arxiv-2406-15629.description: Abstract We introduce a diagrammatic multi-scale approach to the Hubbard model based on the interaction-irreducible (multi-boson) vertex of a small cluster embedded in a self-consistent medium. The vertex captures short-ranged correlations up to the length scale of the cluster, while long-ranged correlations are recovered from a set of diagrammatic equations for the Hedin three-leg vertex.

arxiv-2411-02294.title: Inelastic Coupled-Channel Eikonal Scattering
arxiv-2411-02294.creator: Rafael Aoude, Andrea Cristofoli, Asaad Elkhidir, Matteo Sergola
arxiv-2411-02294.description: Abstract Emitted radiation and absorption effects in black hole dynamics lead to inelastic scattering amplitudes. In this paper, we study how these effects introduce an inelasticity function to the 2 → 2 2\rightarrow 2 eikonalised S S -matrix and how they can be described using unequal mass and spin on-shell amplitudes.

arxiv-2411-05620.title: Planar Abelian Mirror Duals of 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 SQCD 3
arxiv-2411-05620.creator: Sergio Benvenuti, Riccardo Comi, Sara Pasquetti, Gabriel Pedde Ungureanu, Simone Rota, Anant Shri
arxiv-2411-05620.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sergio Benvenuti, Riccardo Comi, Sara Pasquetti, Gabriel Pedde Ungureanu, Simone Rota, Anant Shri. We propose an Abelian mirror dual for the 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 SQCD 3 that we obtain as real mass deformation of known 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 mirror pairs. We match the superconformal index and the 𝐒 b 3 \mathbf{S}^{3}_{b} partition function, discuss the agreement of the moduli spaces, and provide a map of the gauge invariant operators and the global symmetries as evidence of this duality.

arxiv-2505-11313.title: Thermal Static Potential and Pseudo-Scalar Quarkonium Spectral Functions from 2+1 Flavor Lattice QCD
arxiv-2505-11313.creator: Sajid Ali a,b , Dibyendu Bala a , Olaf Kaczmarek a , Pavan a, HotQCD Collaboration
arxiv-2505-11313.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sajid Ali a,b , Dibyendu Bala a , Olaf Kaczmarek a , Pavan a, HotQCD Collaboration. Quarkonia, which are bound states of a heavy quark and antiquark, play a key role in probing the quark-gluon plasma (QGP). The dynamics of quarkonia in the QGP are encoded in their finite-temperature spectral functions.

arxiv-2505-14264.title: AAPO: Enhance the Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs with Advantage Momentum
arxiv-2505-14264.creator: Jian Xiong, Jingbo Zhou, Jingyong Ye, Dejing Dou
arxiv-2505-14264.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jian Xiong, Jingbo Zhou, Jingyong Ye, Dejing Dou. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), especially in scenarios where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) falls short due to limited chain-of-thought (CoT) data. Among RL-based post-training methods, group relative advantage estimation, as exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has attracted considerable attention for eliminating the dependency on the value model, thereby simplifying training compared to traditional approaches like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).

arxiv-2507-03532.title: PhenoBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Cell Phenotyping
arxiv-2507-03532.creator: Fabian H. Reith *,1,2,4,5, Claudia Winklmayr *,4,5, Jérôme Lüscher *,4,5, Nora Koreuber *,1,4,5, Jannik Franzen *,1,3,4,5, Elias Baumann 6, Christian M. Schürch 7,8,9, Dagmar Kainmüller †,3,4,5, Josef Lorenz Rumberger †,2,4,5,🖂
arxiv-2507-03532.description: Abstract Digital pathology has seen the advent of a wealth of foundational models (FM), yet to date their performance on cell phenotyping has not been benchmarked in a unified manner. We therefore propose PhenoBench: A comprehensive benchmark for cell phenotyping on Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained histopathology images.

pmc-12608719.title: The Association of Sugar-Sweetened Beverages Consumption Patterns and Overweight/Obesity: Evidence from a Large-Scale Survey of Chinese Children and Adolescents
pmc-12608719.creator: Yi Liu, Feng Pan, Jin-Lang Lyu, Jian-Wen Li, Jiao Xu, Hai-Jun Wang, Dong Liang, Helmut Schroder
pmc-12608719.description: Objective: To identify major sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) consumption patterns among Chinese children and adolescents and examine their associations with childhood overweight/obesity. pmc-13064721.title: Solutions to common issues in the use of LAIs
pmc-13064721.creator: Stephen R Saklad
pmc-13064721.description: Long-acting injectable (LAI) antipsychotics are highly effective tools for managing serious mental illness, yet their clinical utility is often compromised by logistical and pharmacological complexities. This review serves as a practical guide to optimizing LAI therapy by addressing common clinical hurdles. Maintaining a consistent injection schedule is essential to successful treatment.
